#!/bin/zsh # Prevent system sleep, including lid-close sleep. Persists until switched off. # Only changes SleepDisabled; existing sleep/display timers stay untouched. set -eu
print 'Enabling keep-awake mode (charger and battery).' print 'macOS may ask for your administrator password; typing is invisible.' /usr/bin/sudo /usr/bin/pmset -a disablesleep 1 power_settings=$(/usr/bin/pmset -g) if ! print -r -- "$power_settings" | /usr/bin/awk '$1 == "SleepDisabled" && $2 == 1 { found=1 } END { exit !found }'; then print -u2 'Could not verify SleepDisabled=1. Check: pmset -g' exit 1 fi print 'Keep-awake is ON, including on battery and after restarting.' print 'Run Keep-Mac-Awake-OFF.command to allow sleep again.' print 'Keep the Mac ventilated and preferably plugged in.' print 'The display will turn off in 5 seconds. You can then close the lid.' /bin/sleep 5 if ! /usr/bin/pmset displaysleepnow; then print -u2 'Keep-awake is enabled, but the display-off request failed.' exit 1 fi
